data.rawText:
John Doe
HRIS Developer | HR Systems, Automation & Data Analytics
Phone: +15550100123 | Email: john.doe@example.com | Cairo, Egypt
SUMMARY
HRIS Developer with hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining full-stack HR systems — from SQL databases and
backend services to automated workflows and performance dashboards. Combines strong software development skills (React,
Next.js, .NET, Python, Node.js) with deep HR domain knowledge to translate business requirements into scalable, data-driven
solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making.
EXPERIENCE
HRIS Developer | Northwind Health Group May 2026 – Present
Cairo, Egypt | Official internal title: HR Systems Specialist
● Design, develop, and maintain full-stack HR web applications and portals integrated with enterprise HR systems and
SQL databases.
● Build and administer SQL databases, ensuring data integrity, security, and performance in line with IT governance
standards.
● Develop automated workflows and system integrations to streamline HR processes and reduce manual activities across
departments.
● Design HR dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools to support performance management and operational
decision-making.
● Analyze HR and business requirements and translate them into system enhancements and technical solutions.
● Collaborate with HR and business functions on workflow automation, system integration, and digital transformation
initiatives.
HR Performance Analyst | Meridian Clinics May 2025 – Apr 2026
Cairo, Egypt
● Designed and maintained performance dashboards to monitor workforce KPIs.
● Collected, cleaned, and analyzed large HR datasets to evaluate productivity and efficiency.
● Automated reporting processes, reducing manual workload and improving accuracy.
● Delivered data-driven recommendations to improve performance management systems.
● Collaborated with department heads to optimize workforce planning and resource allocation.
Sales Analyst & Planning | Greenfield Foods Jan 2023 – Apr 2025
Cairo, Egypt
● Analyzed sales and production data to generate actionable business insights.
● Built and maintained Excel-based systems to automate inventory tracking and reporting.
● Created performance dashboards to monitor KPIs and improve operational efficiency.
● Developed forecasting models and strategies to support planning decisions.
Data Entry | Datalink Services Feb 2022 – Apr 2022
Cairo, Egypt
● Entered and organized daily reports with a focus on accuracy and timeliness.
Technical Support | Telco Connect Jan 2020 – Dec 2021
Cairo, Egypt
● Resolved technical issues and provided solutions to enhance customer satisfaction.
EDUCATION
Bachelor's Degree | Nile Delta University
Sep 2015 – Jun 2019 | Cairo, Egypt
SKILLS
• Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js, Node.js
• Backend: C# / .NET, Python (FastAPI, Django), Node.js (NestJS)
• Software Engineering: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns
• DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes
• Data & Systems: SQL (database development, administration, queries, joins, data extraction), HR Information Systems (HRIS)
Development & Maintenance, Business Process Automation & Workflow Design
• Analytics & BI: Microsoft Power BI (DAX, data modeling, data visualization), Excel (advanced formulas, Power Query, dashboards),
Python (pandas, data cleaning, automation)
LANGUAGES
Arabic | English
